units.source_text: 当天，名人在附近漫步了二三百米，这是近两个月里走得最远的一次。

en.t: That day, the Master strolled two or three hundred meters nearby; it was the farthest he had walked in nearly two months.

units.source_text: 在医院里整天卧床，腿脚没劲，出院两周，好歹能坐直了。

en.t: After spending all day in bed at the hospital, his legs had no strength; two weeks after leaving the hospital, he could at least sit upright.
